title: An operator's Home
caption: Zahid signs in as an operator. He sees bills, the daily sheet, customers, suppliers, items and money. There is no Owner dashboard, Accounts or Admin in his menu.

title: An operator making a bill
caption: Billing works the same for staff. A discount over the limit, a bill over a credit limit or a big supplier payment goes to a manager instead.

title: An operator's Money screen
caption: Cash, bank and who owes what are visible for daily work. There is no Bank reconciliation, and staff can't delete anything.
